title: Three tops → one
primary_text:
Three tops became one.
Gym top, beach singlet, going-out shirt. Or one Fight Jersey 2.0: 190GSM breathable mesh, moisture-wicking, four colourways.
$79.95.
headline: Three tops → one.
fidelity: PASS on both sizes (mean pixel difference 0.8 and 2.3 of 255). The three 'other tops' are line drawings, not photos.
notes_for_owner: No saving is claimed: the ad never says what three tops would cost. In Ads Manager, switch off Advantage+ creative enhancements for this ad so Meta does not alter the image.
